# Duos Technologies Group Sets Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call for Monday, November 16, 2026 at 4:30 PM ET


November 09, 2026 4:05pm EST[Download as PDF](https://ir.duostechnologies.com/_assets/_7f95937e502696d1009e567b88cc669f/duostechnologies/news/2026-11-09_Duos_Technologies_Group_Sets_Third_Quarter_2026_861.pdf)


JACKSONVILLE, Fla., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Duos Technologies Group, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=aNfTJpbN-FaP0jJLOGnWJli_IBC-tGDdQFQQZBRqm-BViZWQVJegXH4iuZY1sGuBai67ia9tgeGx3fOWCLlswm9ZbYbN4cSOh5kELD7DdgBfB0xWhjxOea10SQdIycgy) (“Duos” or the “Company”) ([Nasdaq: DUOT](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8RqhJX-E3a7oEIKSNKemafeEzrNNptnalip3z6J0Rgs1r0hBF_5XmXqOUnjW3mmIozMgSvXkJ2KxW-xAyeikxuhDht1UmVeUkGw-bvzpqBg=) ), a provider of adaptive, modular architecture data center colocation and infrastructure solutions, will hold a conference call and webcast on Monday, November 16, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time to discuss its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Company will release its financial results prior to the call via press release, which will be available in the[Investor Relations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=6IoUIzpm3swNsIQy0s9s7GohytL-XD2vzcW23GnjpU9aiAXntdSfPvyzssD1ZyE0w1uScvXxRygzvVbGskpYmm0Wct5uQbOhpo0EdMh05-U=) section of its website.


Duos’ management will host the conference call and webcast, followed by a question-and-answer period.


Conference Call Details:


**Date:** **Monday, November 16, 2026**


**Time:** **4:30 p.m. Eastern time (1:30 p.m. Pacific time)**


**Webcast:**[Register Here for Webcast](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=aUcxV7SN)


**U.S. dial-in:** **+1 877-407-3088**


**International:**[Dial-In Matrix Link](https://www.incommconferencing.com/international-dial-in)


**Confirmation:** **13763733**


Participants are encouraged to dial in 5–10 minutes prior to the start time. An operator will assist with registration.


If you experience any difficulty accessing the call or wish to submit questions in advance, please contact the Company at[DUOT@duostech.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ZGiwhfvURozTaTHJfzMWax-WHD_s3s3UZh-TPnr6JsvyzbJXBpBcbQvaRJjQCrf7dqgEyoaETMgg2m4Ik8ZGz-oEITzWLvvCCLYfcGx50lo=) . An audio replay of the call will also be available in the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website following the event.


For additional information about the Company, please visit:[www.duostechnologies.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mrXrQUeYAGdklle3p4qr311YZ0qvJSgliDVXt8k6I5qMzhmB2hBwPfRSboRqlwzVbOJ9tjr0lZDRNzTpsJEtuSRVp9NK2HMi4JK9p_YgTRzponQ6VMqvxilW68xmPUbv) |[www.duosedge.ai](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mrXrQUeYAGdklle3p4qr3xS_5jGh1f3REW9oR58-ag7MCIQD-AYPW2HYJfVBga0Li4Lufxva-bNIphkkNC7jKw==) .


**About Duos Technologies Group, Inc.**[Duos Technologies Group, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=aNfTJpbN-FaP0jJLOGnWJli_IBC-tGDdQFQQZBRqm-D6YLJ3qPsqPJhJhFQkxWZyGpCt-fGAO7qPuF147cof2LjPJO1oNXZla6Hj1cyzQPj1c5R0UFT0EBiNnCudefX3) (Nasdaq: DUOT), headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, provides and manages modular architecture colocation data centers and infrastructure solutions. Through its Duos Edge AI brand, the Company delivers high-performance computing infrastructure built on its proprietary, scalable Duos Modular Architecture, designed to support the high-power environments required for AI and enterprise computing. Separately, Duos Technology Solutions provides manufacturer-agnostic sourcing and fulfillment services that enable efficient deployment of data centers and IT environments. Together, these platforms position the Company to address growing demand for distributed digital infrastructure in underserved Tier 3 and Tier 4 markets. ##### Duos Technologies Group Sets Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call for Monday, November 16, 2026 at 4:30 PM ET


##### Duos Technologies Group, Inc. (“Duos” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: DUOT), a provider of adaptive, modular architecture data center colocation and infrastructure solutions, will hold a conference call and webcast on Monday, November 16, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time to discuss its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
